title: Senior Product Designer
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We're looking for an experienced and proactive Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team at Zable (Lendable). You'll join a team of 5 product designers and report to the VP of Product & Design.

You'll work mainly on the Zable app, our financial SuperApp with 2M+ monthly active users. It brings together credit cards, loans, memberships, mobile and more in one place. You'll own complex product areas end-to-end, from discovery and research through to polished, production-ready design. You'll set design direction alongside PMs and Engineering, mentor other designers, and help raise the bar for craft and outcomes across the team.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

- 5+ years of product design experience, ideally in fintech or a fast-paced startup

- Strong mobile app and web experience

- Customer-obsessed and data-literate: you challenge solution-led briefs and back decisions with evidence

- Takes real creative risks, and can bring a team along with a clear story for why a bolder direction is right

- Confident with senior stakeholders, and pushes back when quality or customer outcomes are at risk

- AI-native: you push past the first obvious output, not just work faster

- Enjoys raising the bar for other designers through mentoring and feedback

- Bonus:

- Designing AI-powered products (explainability, human override)

- Shipping improvements without engineering, e.g. via CMS or no-code tools

- Regulated environments, e.g. Consumer Duty

- UX writing

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Lead discovery, choosing the right research method and turning findings into clear design direction

- Own design delivery for your squad, from first flows through to build

- Work with engineers throughout design, not just at handoff, weighing build cost in your decisions

- Contribute to the design system, and know when breaking from it is right for the customer

- Run usability tests and experiments with clear measures of success

- Use AI across your workflow, including pushing design changes to production yourself

- Design to Consumer Duty and accessibility standards, and call out issues in others' work

- Run design critiques and write rationale that stands on its own

OUR DESIGN PRINCIPLES

1. Simplicity wins

1. If a user has to think too hard, we’ve already lost. We strip away complexity, jargon, and unnecessary steps to make managing finances effortless. Every screen should feel intuitive, focused, and frictionless.

2. Evidence over ego

1. We don’t design based on opinions. Everything we build is informed by data, tested, and refined

description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Deepgram is looking for a Security Engineer to build and automate the technical controls behind our security program. Most of our infrastructure is bare metal in colocation datacenters - GPU-intensive, running containerized workloads on Docker, managed with Ansible, and shipped through CI/CD on GitHub Actions - with AWS used for overflow capacity and a small set of services. Our engineering culture is high-trust and fast-moving. That means controls have to be delivered as code, be reproducible, and produce their own audit evidence - anything that depends on someone remembering to do it manually will not survive.

You will own real surface area: host hardening and configuration management across the fleet, vulnerability and patch management, penetration testing, container security, detection and response, CI/CD and supply chain security, and the engineering work behind our SOC 2, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001 obligations. You will also be expected to use AI and agentic tooling aggressively to punch above your weight on a small team, and to help us secure the AI systems we build and the AI tools we adopt internally.

This is the hands-on technical seat. A GRC and Security Compliance Lead owns policy authorship, security questionnaires, and the auditor relationship; you own the controls themselves and the evidence they generate, and you give that role the technical answers it needs.

This role reports to the Director of Information Security.

Note: as reflected on our published compensation ranges, we are open on level. Strong mid-level and senior candidates are both in scope, and we will calibrate title, scope, and compensation to demonstrated experience.

ABOUT DEEPGRAM

Deepgram builds foundational voice AI - speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent infrastructure - used by enterprises and developers to build production voice applications at scale. Our models are trained and served on our own infrastructure, and we offer hosted, dedicated single-tenant, and self-hosted deployment options so customers can meet their own data residency and retention requirements. Learn more at deepgram.c

Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable . What You’ll Own:
In this role you’ll build, own, and improve the demand forecast for Skylight ’s ecommerce business: Amazon and DTC, in the US and internationally. You’ll turn performance signals (traffic, conversion, in-stock levels, pricing, promotions) and consumer signals (macro trends and our own customer behavior) into SKU- and channel-level demand plans for Skylight Calendar, Frame, and Buddy. You’ll sit between Commercial, Finance, and Supply Planning so forecasts reflect our pricing and promotional strategy and give Supply Planning what it needs to buy and replenish. You’ll also help shape how we plan as we build out our Demand Planning tool in Pigment.

• Develop and maintain the bottom-up forecast model for DTC and Amazon globally, covering both US and INTL.

• Work with Supply Planning on inventory challenges and opportunities. You own the demand signal, and Supply Planning owns purchasing and replenishment.

title: Associate Portfolio Manager - Retail
description:
What is Teamshares ?

Teamshares is a mission-driven startup that buys small businesses from retiring owners and transitions them into enduring, employee-owned businesses through our software, education, and community products. There wasn't an easy way for small businesses, which make up 98% of firms in the US economy, to become employee-owned before Teamshares .

We are seeking a strategic, results-oriented Associate Portfolio Manager to help oversee a group of 4-6 small to mid-sized businesses across the specialty food and beverage retail sector. This is an emerging portfolio leader role reporting to a senior Industry Lead, who retains ultimate P&L ownership for the portfolio. However, you will be accountable for driving financial performance, strategic alignment, and day-to-day portfolio support across the companies you cover. The ideal candidate is analytically rigorous, an emerging coach to business leaders, and a trusted liaison to the parent company.

You will not manage daily operations. Instead, you will drive financial performance through company leaders and your senior Industry Lead. Success in this role requires an ability to balance analytical work with a hands-on understanding of business fundamentals.

Responsibilities:

• Financial analysis: Support P&L management across the portfolio. Help business leaders build annual plans, and track achievement of revenue, EBITDA, and cash flow targets.

• Leadership support: Support the leaders of each portfolio company. Develop into a coach and accountability partner over time.

• Performance management: Track and drive KPIs across businesses. Identify underperformance and work collaboratively to implement turnaround strategies.

• Change management and execution: Help portfolio companies navigate periods of change, including leadership transitions, process improvements, implementation of new systems or initiatives.

• Strategic planning: Partner with company leaders to develop growth plans, capital investment strategies, and operational improvements.

• Reporting and communication: Serve as a point of contact between the network companies and Teamshares . Prepare and present regular updates on performance, risks, and opportunities.

• Synergy and optimization: Identify and drive cross-portfolio synergies, including shared services, procurement, and best practices.

• Governance and compliance: Help ensure that all businesses operate within legal, ethical, and financial standards.

Qualifications:

• 2-3 years in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, FP&A, or business operations, or similarly analytical and high accountability environment.

• Strong financial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and performance analysis

• Demonstrated analytical rigor, including building P&L analyses and operating models from first principles

• Ability to build trust and influence experienced operators without direct authority

• Comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed financial and operational work

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with an interest in coaching business leaders

• Entrepreneurial mindset: Comfortable operating in an environment with imperfect information, evolving priorities, and limited resources.

• Willingness to travel periodically to portfolio company locations, with the frequency varying based on business needs.

• Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field (MBA or similar preferred)
